events.title: Tupac Shakur shooting anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, legendary rapper Tupac Shakur was critically wounded in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, an incident that tragically led to his death six days later.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: 27 years ago today, the music world was shaken by the shooting of Tupac Shakur. His impact on hip-hop and culture remains undeniable. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix death anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering rock icon Jimi Hendrix, who tragically passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost the legendary Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever. Which Hendrix track is on repeat for you today?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on this day in 1969, featuring classic tracks like 'Something' and 'Come Together'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Turns 57
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From the legendary zebra crossing to the incredible tracklist, it's an album that still sounds fresh. What's your favourite moment?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and songwriting with The Pretenders continue to inspire. What's your top Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher turns 54 today! The voice of a generation and a true rock 'n' roll star. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic 'Imagine' album, featuring the timeless title track, was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years ago today, John Lennon released his powerful 'Imagine' album. Its message of peace and hope resonates just as strongly now. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: First iPod unveiled 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music and putting "1,000 songs in your pocket".

angles.name: iPod 25th Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the first time you got an iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple unveiled the device that changed how we carry our music. Pure nostalgia!

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007's cinematic legacy. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the life and music of John Lennon. His message of peace continues to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', he's given us so many laughs. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their experimental self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Turns 58
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece that still sparks debate. What's your go-to track from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Freddie Mercury death anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45, leaving behind an incredible musical legacy.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the one and only Freddie Mercury. His voice, showmanship, and songs are truly immortal. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on this day in 1965, marking a significant artistic progression for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: It's been 61 years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game. An album that pushed boundaries and set new standards for pop music. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon death anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the life and enduring legacy of John Lennon, who was tragically killed on this day in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Remembered
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. What's his most impactful song for you?
